Virginia Woolf, The Voyage Out.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/virginia-woolf/the-voyage-out

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Virginia Woolf, the author, died 1941.

First publication of the text used: 1915 (SE colophon: 'The Voyage Out was published in 1915 by Virginia Woolf.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1915, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 2010.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each of them has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die did so in 1941, so the work is public domain in each of these countries.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
